concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-platforms-in-person-payments]] — 2023-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Platforms POS/Terminal API and Mobile prerequisites, split precedence, liable-account default and standalone profile-only limit; diagram values are illustrative, not financial outcomes.
warnings: Terminal/Mobile route, Transfers API credentials, webhook acceptance and account-holder receivePayments/receiveFromPlatformPayments capabilities are documented prerequisites, not evidence of live enablement or current country eligibility.
With no profile or API split instructions, full amount and fees book to the platform liable balance account; per-request instructions override profiles, but standalone supports profiles only.
The USD 620 split/settlement/payout diagram is an example and does not establish a merchant's legal seller, authorized payment, completed settlement or bank receipt.
